transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I've been struggling with a really low, depressed mood and constant sadness for a very long time now. It has been going on continuously for about two years and three months, and I just can't seem to shake it.
Have you had any periods of feeling back to your usual self for more than two months during this time?
No, I haven't had any periods where I felt like my usual self at all. This depressed mood and sadness have been completely continuous and persistent for the entire two years and three months.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were Persistent Depressive Disorder and Major Depressive Disorder, but the patient reports a continuously depressed mood for about two years and three months with no period of feeling back to baseline for more than two months. This chronic, non-episodic course supports Persistent Depressive Disorder and makes Major Depressive Disorder less likely, since MDD is typically characterized by discrete episodes rather than a continuous depressed mood over this duration.
